about_the_game:
Adventures Await!

Frog Odyssey is a turn-based auto-battler where frog heroes, guided by honesty and courage, confront corrupted animals whose bad habits disturb the balance of the land. Buy and combine ingredients to craft special dishes, feed them to your frogs, and unlock powerful bonuses as you restore peace across the world.

Unique Characters !

Recruit and upgrade frogs with different abilities, creating powerful synergies and strategies.

Delicious Food !

Buy and combine ingredients to craft special dishes, then feed them to your frogs for game-changing bonuses.

Story

In a world where not all creatures live by honesty and fairness, the frog heroes rise to defend what is right. Guided by their unwavering values, they cannot ignore the harm caused by those who fall into selfish habits.

What begins as small disturbances soon grows into chaos spreading across the land. Food is stolen, trust is broken, and harmony between creatures begins to fade. The frogs know that if no one stands against this, their world will fall deeper into disorder.

And so, they set out on a heroic journey. Through each encounter, they face animals who have strayed from the path of virtue, challenging them in battle to reveal the strength of honesty, courage, and justice.

It is a quest to restore balance and remind the world that true strength comes from values worth defending.

Still in development...

Stay up to date by adding the game to your Wishlist and following us on social media.
